scope: Content spot checks prompted by low MIDI-to-supplemental-data note-count ratios. The unchanged MuseScore MIDI is the playback source; the separate MusicRender data is supplemental archive evidence, not a reference audio performance.
method: Compare ordered eight-pitch phrases within corresponding parts, independent of timing, and inspect the final twelve note pitches in every part.
limitations: Phrase matches can recur and do not prove exact note-for-note fidelity, every inner passage, or all written repeats. Supplemental MusicRender timing and note counts differ from MuseScore playback and cannot alone establish truncation.
